name: Instant Pages
description: Makes clicking around your site feel instant: pages start loading while a visitor points at a link, and fade smoothly into each other. No scripts.

panels.title: Instant pages
panels.description: Loads the next page early and smooths the change between pages, using features built into modern browsers. Other browsers work exactly as before. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Make pages feel instant
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

choices.title: When the pointer rests on a link (fastest)
When a link is pressed (uses the least data)

fields.name: mode
fields.title: How much to load ahead
fields.description: Preparing the whole page makes it appear at once; downloading only saves the wait for the network.

fields.name: transition
fields.title: Change between pages
fields.description: Visitors who ask their device for less motion always get a plain change.

fields.name: skip-links
fields.title: Never load these ahead
fields.description: Addresses separated by commas, for example /shop/cart, /downloads/*. Sign-in, checkout, admin and similar addresses are always skipped.
